scope: Working integrated mechanism/control/verification crosswalk, not a complete formal safety case or accepted risk assessment.

hazards.title: Track twist unloads an individual wheel
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: Four rail contact points are not coplanar. Rigid truck/guide/body constraints redistribute spring and wheel loads; a light wheel can lose guidance/braking reserve even with a0%mean grade.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Solve actual wheel/axlebox spring lever arms, truck flexibility/equalization, body support law and new/worn/empty/loaded wheel loads. Spring force is not automatically wheel reaction. Accept combined twist/curve/lateral/dynamic evidence.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: Guide tilt and brake reaction bind suspension
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: Wheelset tilt in a long close-fitting guide, or a second incompatible rigid brake-reaction link, can lock intended motion and distort bearings/carrier while transferring unintended forces into frame.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Define permitted translations/rotations and compliant joints, bearing/guide alignment and actual maximum service/spring/fault reactions; verify combined motion under load, not a projected clearance alone.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: Wheel/axle/bearing or removable-hub retention fails
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: Unaccepted press fits, rotating-axle bearing setting, axle fatigue or removable drum-hub joint can loosen/fracture and lose wheel guidance or brake torque. Semi-trailer stationary-spindle geometry is not the same load path.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Complete controlled wheel/rail profile, wheel-seat/journal/hub fit and fatigue/retention arrangement, materials/heat/NDT and exact bearing support; preserve bearing and pressed wheel during hub/drum service without compromising axle retention.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: Body rolls, lifts or separates from truck
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: Wide occupied body, mass/CG changes, lateral acceleration/wind, sidebearer contact or failed pivot retention can unload wheels, strike structure or separate body/truck.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Accept whole-coach mass/CG and combined roll/curve/wind/twist loads, actual center/pivot/sidebearer geometry and retention, clearance and structural path. Neither nominal gauge nor free spring travel proves stability.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: Spring/damper/stop seat overload or loss of retention
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: Empty/loaded travel, spring solid height/unseating, damper end load or stop impact can fail a seat/guide/frame or damage the aligned brake assembly.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Choose actual force/travel/envelope/damping/stop energy and load paths after masses/motions are established; qualify upper/lower seat joints and drop-out retention. Trial8coils and heave frequencies are not selected hardware.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: D1 maximum applied torque overwhelms custom support
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: Sizing carrier/hub/cam/chamber support only for target deceleration ignores higher service/spring/fault torque and reversing sign; support or retention may fail before a wheel can safely transmit it.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Obtain exact delivered D1 curves/envelopes and matched geometry; design hub/carrier/axlebox/guide/frame joints for accepted governing combinations, heat/fatigue and full movement. Keep OEM drum mounting-face orientation.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: Brake force is excessive or uncontrollable on rail
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: D1 family match does not establish low-torque modulation, reverse behavior or empty/loaded adhesion balance. Service/spring compounding can slide wheels or produce high jerk/asymmetry.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Map pressure/stroke/output torque and spring transfer, wear/temperature and both directions; accept load control, anti-compounding and wheel-slide/fault response on actual wheel/rail/consist.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: Air trainline loss does not stop both separated portions
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: Wrong/self-sealed connector, closed cock, masked BP leak, depleted reserve or electrical-jumper persistence can leave a vehicle/portion without commanded braking. MR-held spring release does not necessarily vent with BP loss.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Complete actual BP/MR/valve/connector/permit design and usable reserve:32coach chambers plus separate locomotive/lines/valves. Prove every joint/both portions and isolation/feed/vent faults, not pressure at the locomotive only.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: Normal pressure indication hides mechanical brake failure
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: Relay/pilot pressure or software state can appear correct while cam/slack/lining/drum/hub/carrier is failed, dragging or not producing wheel torque; service and spring sections share mechanical elements.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Coordinate delivered-pressure, mechanical stroke/condition/output/release and heat/slide evidence; detect disagreement and prohibit dispatch. Do not credit a second chamber section as mechanical redundancy.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: Parking or maintenance release permits rollaway
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: Unproved spring holding, caging, air/power changes, uncoupling or the service-to-spring handover can remove restraint while people board or service the train.0%target is not an independent restraint.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Accept parked/boarding/storage/rescue holding and independent task-specific restraint, actual force handover and restore/retest. No generic caging or vent-all-air procedure; disabled brakes remain out of passenger service.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: Coupling or frame attachment fails under compression/slack
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: Braking imbalance, reversing, draft slack/impact or articulation can overload eye/pin/retainer/clevis/draft/frame joints. Catalog bearing force or nominal bar stress does not rate the complete coupling.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Complete accepted force/duty/slack/fatigue and articulation, pin/eye fits and retention, draft gear, secondary restraint, guards and main-frame load path; qualify actual joints and protected service access.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: Nominal frame/detail geometry is cut as released steel
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: J1a member envelopes omit local I1connections/support/brakes/couplings. End-plane lengths, sharp-corner HSS and weld representations can be mistaken for shop lengths, delivered profiles or qualified welds.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Integrate actual receiving members/joints, fit-up/end preparation/distortion, supported material/WPS/fatigue/inspection and access. Link every part/connection ID and actual drawing revision; source identity is not adequacy.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: Seat load bypass bears on or damages floor
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: O1 finds nominal zero vertical isolation between I-SH1 sole and floor stack. Tolerances, floor/seat deflection and thermal movement can transfer load into unqualified panel/insert/seal or loosen attachment.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Revise the coupled sole/cap/spacer/opening/fastener/seal stack with positive accepted clearance under governing loads/temperature. Qualify exact seat/panel coupon;64regular feet are not the accessible schedule.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: Accessible body and boarding loads are inferred from regular car
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: Stage2 accessible31display objects/28in floor and regular110-member/64hardpoint structure are different incomplete representations. Wheelchair/lift/door/companion loads and evacuation can bypass unqualified structure.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Separate actual accessible support/door-frame/securement and occupied circulation, accepted floor states and real boarding/rescue equipment; retain11fixed+2chair layout as trial geometry, not rated occupancy.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: Door/glazing/body/roof failure obstructs egress or injures people
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: Unspecified wall/roof/door sections, glazing retention, moving hardware or emergency release can fail under passenger/vehicle/HVAC/weather loads or trap people.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Develop actual materials/joints/openings/fire-weather/drainage and structural paths, roof ring and door/egress controls; validate occupied paths and hardware in actual configured bodies.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: Platform/stair/lift contact, collapse or movement during boarding
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: Unaccepted loaded floor, suspension unloading, hinge/stow locks or sweep allows falls, pinch points, collision with truck/coupling/track or loss of bridge support.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Set actual mechanism/mounts/guards/locks and stopped/travel modes with floor/roll/twist states, physical holding, accepted station interface and qualified recovery. Walking-plane32/36in studies and7/11benchmark are not vehicle stair construction/code.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: Engine/drive power or controls cause uncontrolled motion/heat
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: Intermittent engine ceiling, unaccepted hydrostatic low-speed/retarding behavior, branch-flow fault, shaft side load or torsional/motion conflict can lose traction control, overheat or fail drive joints.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Use actual continuous/derated maps and supported reduction/couplings/axle drives; accept limiting/fault/reversing and cooling. Separate traction function from train service/emergency/parking brakes.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: Fuel/exhaust/hotel power endangers enclosed occupied cars
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: Diesel exhaust/regeneration, fuel leak/hot surfaces or poor ventilation/intake separation can cause fire/smoke/CO exposure; attractive steam-era shell can obstruct cooling/service and detection.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Design actual enclosure/cooling/fuel/fire/exhaust routing and both-direction occupied intake separation; accepted material/egress/detection and incident plan. No universal separation distance or historical-shell construction is inferred.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: Power loss/fault/backfeed defeats braking or emergency functions
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: Wrong neutral/bond/protection, moving connector damage, start transient or shared reserve causes electric shock/fire or loss of brake/egress/lighting/communication functions.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Complete actual one-line/fault/bonding/neutral/source isolation and emergency reserve. Assign compressor once, remove obsolete DC-B07 loads, prove current simultaneous start/loss/recharge states and protected restart.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: HVAC/roof data mismatch or condensate blocks safe use
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: Wrong opening/clearance/ADB variant, unqualified gasket/support or poor drain/outdoor-air path can lose roof integrity, headroom, weather seal or occupied ventilation and contaminate electrical/brake/boarding surfaces.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Reconcile exact unit/ADB/manual and physical clamp/service stack, headroom/CG/loads, real outdoor-air flow and condensate routing. Thermal/electrical budget alone is not a mount or ventilation design.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: Rail/joint/turnout incompatibility or site defect derails train
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: 30ASCE linkedCAD differs from paper; joint bolt/bar dimensions vary. Gauge alone, unknown wheel/rail profile, poor support/drainage or crossing/turnout geometry can lose contact/gauge restraint.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Keep mismatched CAD quarantined; engineer matched profile/rail/condition/joints/ties/fastening/formation and actual survey/curves/transitions/turnouts/stations. Accept proof section and as-built geometry, not mean grade alone.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: Unprotected route/reversing/second train or public crossing collision
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: Unknown occupancy, turnout position/fouling, lost communication or pushing with poor leading visibility can collide with people/vehicles/train or destabilize compressed couplings.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Accept route/crossing/public separation and dispatch/protection/fault behavior. Conditional one-direction-loop preference is not an alignment or two-train/reversing authorization.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: Stored energy, lifting or service removal injures crew
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: Zero air gauge, cab-off or nominal level track can hide spring/gravity/hydraulic/electrical energy. Unsupported hub/drum, loaded guide/reaction joint or underbody work can move unexpectedly.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Qualified task-specific independent restraint, engineered lifting/support, all-source isolation and continuing verification; exact OEM spring service only. No generic caging, vent-all-air, lifting point or field proof-load instruction.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: False acceptance from obsolete tests, proxies or changed build
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: Old hydraulic E03, G1display parts, mockup success, sourcehash, coupon proof or pressure indication can be misrepresented as current D1/complete-train acceptance; repairs/substitutions may invalidate prior evidence.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Use exact current configuration crosswalk and controlled as-built/defect/regression records, calibrated raw measurements and responsible dispositions. No invented risk score, acceptance setting, witness or engineering release.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated

hazards.title: Evacuation relies on unqualified equipment or vehicle movement
hazards.mechanism_and_consequence: Fire/blocked track/power loss prevents recovery to a station; inaccessible terrain, failed lift/light or floor movement during unloading can expose or strand passengers.
hazards.design_response_to_define_and_prove: Accept independent site rescue access, lighting/communication, qualified installed boarding/egress equipment and controlled assisted-evacuation holding across changing load state. Distinguish urgent escape from controlled unloading; E14 before participant E13.
hazards.control_status: Proposed requirements/documentation only; physical implementation and acceptance not demonstrated
